name: nocodb-dev
description: NocoDB schema development plugin. Meta API v3 via curl and MCP (schema tools on Cloud/licensed through listTools/callTool) — tables, fields (35 types), views (9 types), filters, sorts, hooks (HookV3), comments, scripts, dashboards & widgets, workflows, documents, plus workspaces / members / teams / tokens. Bundles both Data API and Meta API OpenAPI specs.
